AN-22/task:
Task AN-22 — Step pose sheet: one figure moving two edges. Trigger: CUE-007 fighter moved (state.fighter_moved); the move starts on the frame the snapshot is applied. Timing: 280 ms per edge at x1, the same for every edge whatever its length; linear inside the path, no stop at a vertex; ease-in during the first E ms of the first edge and ease-out during the last E ms of the last edge, E = 80 ms x (T / 280) and at most T / 2, so the edge time T and the arrival time do not change; edge progress s(t) = k t^2 / (2 Ein) for t < Ein, k (t - Ein/2) in the middle, 1 - k (T - t)^2 / (2 Eout) for t > T - Eout, with k = 1 / (T - Ein/2 - Eout/2); start turn <= 50 ms; turn at a vertex 120 ms on the move; travel lean 10 deg forward, in over 60 ms; hop height 0; back to idle in 150 ms after the arrival (lean to 0, facing back to the idle three-quarter rule); speed x0.5 = 140 ms per edge, x1.5 = 420 ms, minimum step 90 ms, caps 1400 ms per fighter and 2400 ms per sequence; reduced motion and speed none snap to the end cell at 0 ms; CUE-007 dust on the end cell 300 ms from the arrival. Keyframes: 0 ms: idle three-quarter on the start cell, start turn begins, speed 0; 40 ms: 1/24 of the first edge (linear would be 1/7); 50 ms: facing the first edge; 60 ms: lean 10 deg reached; 80 ms: ease-in ends at 1/6 of the first edge, then 1/240 edge per ms; 280 ms: vertex, turn to the second edge over 120 ms without a stop; 480 ms: ease-out starts; 560 ms: arrival on the end cell, speed 0, dust starts; 710 ms: lean 0 and idle facing restored. Single-edge path: k = 1/200 edge per ms, ease-in 0-80 ms, ease-out 200-280 ms.

Sheet layout 1920x1080, background #061623, text Roboto Bold Condensed / Regular:
- top: time axis in ms and, for clips, frames at 24 fps; phases as bars with labels from the keyframes above;
- middle: 4-6 key poses as flat silhouettes (card.cream fill, #111317 keyline) with the camera direction arrow; facing rules: idle three-quarter to the camera (<= 45 deg off the camera axis), turn to the target 120 ms before the lunge, return in 150 ms, never back to the camera; step tilt 10 deg, no hop, ease 80 ms at path ends;
- bottom: CUE events on the same axis (contact notify, flash 70 ms, damage number +60 ms, HP +80 ms), the reduced-motion variant and the speed variants x0.5 / x1 / x1.5 / none.
Every number on the sheet must appear in the timing above or in docs/game-design/visual/02-visual-design.md 8.3-8.4, 9.2; list the source of each number in README.
Specific to this sheet: two lanes, King Arthur (hero) and a Harpy (sidekick); silhouettes from the left (side) tiles of the Idle Blender sheets, tilted 10 deg forward around the base centre, base flat on the ground line, no hop; a position graph s(t) for both edges with the ease curve solid #F2C14E and the linear legacy curve dashed #B9B2A6; the path as a line #FFC857 between three abstract cell discs (not a real board); the bottom row shows CUE-007 dust at 560-860 ms instead of combat events, the speed lanes x0.5 and x1.5 and the reduced-motion snap.   (#061623, #F9EBDB, #111317, #F2EDE4, #B9B2A6, #F2C14E, #FFC857), with anti-aliased edge pixels excluded (a pixel is an

  Drop the 960x540 copies (an overview size is not a working size of this sheet) or render them natively too; write
  which. Record downscaled_from_master: false for every working copy.

  1) phases sum to 560 ms to the arrival and 710 ms with the settle (tolerance 42 ms);
  2) s(80 ms) = 1/6 of the first edge;
  3) no stop at the vertex (smallest speed between 80 and 480 ms, measured on the timing contract);
  4) lean 10 deg visible on the silhouettes: measure it on the rendered master (the axis angle of each leaned pose
     minus the axis angle of the idle pose of the same lane, from the drawn pixels, not from the transform matrix;
     tolerance 1 deg) and no hop (the base line y of all twelve poses equal);
  5) no pose with the back to the camera (the facing arrows of all twelve poses within 90 deg of the camera direction,
     idle poses within 45 deg);
  6) every number has its source in README: list every number drawn on the sheet (from text-bounds.json) and the README
     row that gives its source; unmatched numbers = 0;
  7) colour and grayscale sheets exist (master and 1280x720);
  8) verification.json has source_unchanged true and outside_folder [].

Timing: 280 ms per edge at x1, the same for every edge whatever its length; linear inside the path, no stop at a vertex; ease-in during the first E ms of the first edge and ease-out during the last E ms of the last edge, E = 80 ms x (T / 280) and at most T / 2, so the edge time T and the arrival time do not change; edge progress s(t) = k t^2 / (2 Ein) for t < Ein, k (t - Ein/2) in the middle, 1 - k (T - t)^2 / (2 Eout) for t > T - Eout, with k = 1 / (T - Ein/2 - Eout/2); start turn <= 50 ms; turn at a vertex 120 ms on the move; travel lean 10 deg forward, in over 60 ms; hop height 0; back to idle in 150 ms after the arrival (lean to 0, facing back to the idle three-quarter rule); speed x0.5 = 140 ms per edge, x1.5 = 420 ms, minimum step 90 ms, caps 1400 ms per fighter and 2400 ms per sequence; reduced motion and speed none snap to the end cell at 0 ms; CUE-007 dust on the end cell 300 ms from the arrival. Keyframes: 0 ms: idle three-quarter on the start cell, start turn begins, speed 0; 40 ms: 1/24 of the first edge (linear would be 1/7); 50 ms: facing the first edge; 60 ms: lean 10 deg reached; 80 ms: ease-in ends at 1/6 of the first edge, then 1/240 edge per ms; 280 ms: vertex, turn to the second edge over 120 ms without a stop; 480 ms: ease-out starts; 560 ms: arrival on the end cell, speed 0, dust starts; 710 ms: lean 0 and idle facing restored. Single-edge path: k = 1/200 edge per ms, ease-in 0-80 ms, ease-out 200-280 ms.
